# Supply network description: Widget

This document describes the "Widget supply network". The network has 7 echelons and 10000 nodes: 834 tier-2 suppliers, 834 tier-1 suppliers, 834 component plants, 834 assembly plants, 834 central distribution centres, 833 regional distribution centres and 4997 customers. Planning uses periods of 1 day over a horizon of 90 periods; durations are rounded to the nearest period. The network handles 1 product: Widget (unit value 71).
